flight-volume.reason: Volume reconstruction removed the short pathline spikes but blurred the wake into a generic smoke band. It did not solve the material identity problem.

glass-continuous-to-fragments.reason: The forming mesh changed topology and appearance abruptly at release. The replacement keeps the same fragments throughout the shot.

seismic-swept-sample.reason: The continuous brown sample resembled a leather ribbon and concealed the wave response. The replacement uses a granular witness and stronger solved displacement.
